QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusader] Orientation
QuestInfo.0: Ask Bastille which Silent Crusade mission you should take on next.
QuestInfo.1: Starling is in charge of training new members. You should visit her first if you want to progress as a member of the Silent Crusade.
QuestInfo.2: Starling is in charge of training new members. You should visit her first if you want to progress as a member of the Silent Crusade.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#

Can proceed to [Silent Crusade] Nihal Desert Dispatch

0.0: We'll start you off with something simple, though I get the odd feeling that you are up for much greater challenges. Go see Starling.

yes.0: Starling will act as your guide for a time. Silent Crusaders must be able to function independently, but she will assist you in getting on your feet. Who knows, you two might go together very well!

no.0: Do you regret joining our cause already? I thought you were tougher than this. Come back and see me when you're ready.

1.0: I knew you'd make it! I've got a real eye for talent.

npc.0: Starling should be able to give you the information you need.
